unexecuted_static_fixes: Allocate MAP_SHARED operands one at a time and append each successful allocation immediately, so a later allocation failure cannot orphan earlier mappings.
Mathematical oracle writes a prefix only when its length is nonzero; Python slice insertion at a huge index is not the HIA zero-prefix behavior.
Removed an unused local resource observation; all actual process-limit and wait4 records remain.
CPU_boundary: The whole standalone runner, including both B3 compiles and every reaped native child, must fit 90 CPU / 180 wall / 1 GiB. Enclosing common.run checks its complete child CPU and wall receipt independently.
source_proof_boundary: No DMS author or original ten-control digest proof is edited. Any future owner integration requires original proof before unique exact helper rewrite.
